import argparse,os,sys,tempfile,time
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import coord
long='logs/'+'a'*105
cases={'whole topic':('logs/otel-python-sdk',[]),'long topic, whole':(long,[]),'long topic, terms':(long,['batch size','export interval']),'non-ASCII term':('logs/otel-python-sdk',['gęślą jaźń'])}
bad=[];readable=None
for name,fp in cases.items():
    coord.fingerprint=lambda q,t=None,fp=fp:fp
    s=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'c.sqlite')
    try:
        b=coord.dedup(argparse.Namespace(store=s,holder='h',topic=None,token=None,ttl=60,question='q'),time.time)
    except Exception as e:
        bad.append((name,'raised '+e.__class__.__name__+': '+str(e)[:80]));continue
    bad+=[(name,k) for k in b.get('claimed',[]) if not coord.FIELD_VALUE.fullmatch(k)]
    if name=='non-ASCII term':
        readable=any('gesla' in k for k in b.get('claimed',[]))
print('claimed past FIELD_VALUE:',bad,'non-ASCII term readable:',readable)
sys.exit(0 if not bad and readable else 1)
